--- title: Grid Pattern date: 2023-07-18 description: A background grid pattern made with SVGs, fully customizable using Tailwind CSS. author: dillionverma published: true video: https://cdn.magicui.design/grid-pattern.mp4 --- ## Installation CLI Manual ```bash npx shadcn@latest add @magicui/grid-pattern ``` Copy and paste the following code into your project. Update the import paths to match your project setup. ## Examples ### Linear Gradient ### Dashed Stroke ### Usage ```tsx showLineNumbers import { GridPattern } from "@/components/ui/grid-pattern" ``` ```tsx showLineNumbers
``` ## Props ### GridPattern | Prop | Type | Default | Description | | ----------------- | -------- | ------- | --------------------------------------------- | | `width` | `number` | `40` | Width of the pattern | | `height` | `number` | `40` | Height of the pattern | | `x` | `number` | `-1` | X offset of the pattern | | `y` | `number` | `-1` | Y offset of the pattern | | `squares` | `number` | `[]` | X Y coordinates of filled squares as 2D array | | `strokeDasharray` | `string` | `0` | Stroke dash array for the pattern |
